title: Convergence-Symmetric Metric Spaces
summary: We study some basic properties of spaces which satisfy the usual axioms of a metric space but without the symmetry axiom. We realised that such a study is needed in view of the relatively recent appearance of several papers on natural asymmetric metrics to which the available theories do not apply. One prominent example is Thurston's metric on the Teichm{ü}ller spaces of hyperbolic surfaces of finite type, introduced by Thurston in 1985, with several variants and generalisations.
